Visitor removes all horizontal rules

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
visitor = Class.new do
  def visit_horizontal_rule(*args)
    'skip'
  end
end.new
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Part 1</p><hr><p>Part 2</p><hr><p>Part 3</p>', visitor)
puts result.inspect
```
